body.name: Finite breakpoint endpoint model
body.construction: For each type, collect \(0\), \(1\), and all cumulative probabilities in its rows recovered from positive source parent contexts; insert the selected optimizer \(qminus\) or \(qplus\) for the free binary row; sort distinct breakpoints; assign one noise atom to each adjacent interval with mass equal to its length; let the shared type mechanism output the category selected by any interior point; give distinct ground nodes independent copies of this type-level noise; and serialize in \(Z\) every source and target grounding dictated by \(Ictx\).
